core_obligations: Replace the local ring at the point by the maximum over the finitely many irreducible components through it (proof lines 13626-13636).
Identify the generic points appearing in the correction term and factor each component through the closure of the image of its generic point (proof lines 13636-13642).
Apply the dimension formula on each component and combine to obtain the stated inequality (proof lines 13642-13647).

difficulty_reason: The lemma generalises the dimension formula to an arbitrary morphism locally of finite type over a locally Noetherian base, bounding the dimension of the local ring at a point by the dimension of the local ring at its image plus a correction term, minus the transcendence degree of the residue field extension, where the correction term is the largest transcendence degree of a residue field over the residue field of the image of the corresponding generic point. The proof passes to the finitely many irreducible components through the point with their reduced structure, rewrites the local dimension as the maximum over those components and identifies the generic points appearing in the correction term, factors each component through the closure of the image of its generic point, and applies the dimension formula to the induced morphism between the component and that closure.
